name: faq-global-marketplace-managePaymentsAndBillAccounts

fields.accordionHeading: How can I manage my payments and billing accounts?
fields.accordionDescription:
For all billing-related activities, go to My Bill at the top of this page (Sign Up/Manage AutoPay, Make Payments, etc.).
Only a main Subscriber or a dependent authorized by a Subscriber can utilize this feature.

tags: Manage my payments and billing accounts
